notes.title: Major update #1: Red desert map and CTF mode are out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763529/508685f5a391b454f83fe4c75c5a495148c793af.png[/img]

Red desert is out! 

Oval's first capture the flag map features 2km x 2km area, giving players thrilling chase moments and flag defenses with this huge map.

Take a look to the map's trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LhNnV82sqdY

Our next step in the roadmap is migrating to a new network system to allow cross platform servers. This will improve latency too.

Don't forget to join discord and send us your feedback: https://discord.gg/GrFVXfM

notes.title: Minor update #1: New UI, fixes and minor changes.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763529/508685f5a391b454f83fe4c75c5a495148c793af.png[/img]

Hi,

We've started to post the update's log here and today we've a pretty good one.

In this update Oval has a better user interface and some extra changes and fixes:
[list]
    [*]New menu UI, last one didn't work well on all environments.
    [*]Now abilities are equiped on buy.
    [*]Sync fire and thrusters effect.
    [*]Discord fixed time between bot messages.
    [*]Discord messages to update player number.
    [*]Abilities fully charged when the game starts.
    [*]Joining forever: fixed
    [*]New timer UI when the Oval drops.
[/list]

We keep working on the new map as well, we're still fixing issues with your help and will be publicly available soon.

Join our discord server! https://discord.gg/GrFVXfM

notes.title: The discord integration update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763529/cfe5b251cd9b512173ca4b6db5357887a2f284bc.png[/img]

Hi!

Oval has a new cool feature to improve the community flow. There's a lot of people playing the game but there were no way to know that from outside of the game. 

With this update we introduce a brand new way to let you to meet people and play with them. Every time a player creates a match you will be able to see that in our discord channel meet-and-play!

The community is growing a lot these days and this gives you a new way to find players.

Join our discord to unleash this new feature!: https://discord.gg/GrFVXfM
